Research Tools

Open-source tools I've developed for clinical neuroscience research

📊

Vol-HD

Published in Movement Disorders, 2024

Online calculator for predicting striatal volumes in Huntington's Disease patients, enabling pre-screening for clinical trials of intrastriatal therapeutics.

Huntington's Disease MRI Volumetrics Clinical Trials
📄 Paper → 🔗 Calculator →
🧠

CNN-PD

Code Available · Manuscript in Preparation

Convolutional neural network for automated detection of Parkinson's Disease from healthy controls using structural T1-weighted MRI data.

Parkinson's Disease Deep Learning MRI Classification
💻 GitHub →
📈

Negida-FE-Toolbox

Published on GitHub · Papers Pending

Feature extraction toolbox for extracting dominant frequency features from EEG signals in patients with neurodegenerative diseases.

EEG Analysis Feature Extraction Neurodegeneration
💻 GitHub →
🔬

PD-MCI Ch4 Subtyping Tool

Published in Parkinsonism & Related Disorders, 2025

Real-time subtyping of PD-MCI patients by Ch4 (nucleus basalis of Meynert) gray matter density using advanced neuroimaging analysis.

Parkinson's Disease MCI Subtyping Neuroimaging
📄 Paper → 🔗 Tool →
🎯

PD Subtyping Tool

Published in npj Parkinson's Disease, 2025

Interactive tool for clinical, pathological, and data-driven subtyping of Parkinson's Disease. Comprehensive framework for precision medicine approaches.

Parkinson's Disease Disease Subtyping Precision Medicine
📄 Paper → 🔗 Tool →
